title: Test plan
description: Written from the acceptance criteria and current behaviour only, without the design spec. Every test case traces to one criterion; the build record and test report refer to test case ids.

test_cases.description: At least one per acceptance criterion, plus negative cases (missing, deleted, malformed input).

criterion_id.description: The acceptance criterion this case proves.

level.description: unit and integration cases become automated tests in the build record; system cases run on the deployed stand and land in the test report.

negative.description: True for missing, deleted or malformed input cases.

preconditions.description: Data and state required. For system cases: records to seed through the real pipeline, or existing ones to reuse.

expected.description: The exact observable result: a value, a state, an error message.

environments.description: Where each level runs, e.g. 'unit, integration: local test database'; 'system: shared stand'.

entry_criteria.description: What must hold before system testing starts, e.g. 'CI green on the head'.

exit_criteria.description: What must hold to call testing done, e.g. 'every system case passes'.

test_cases.title: History lists every saved version newest first
History page shows the version used for shipping
